method: Heuristic, not a PvPoke simulation. Each member is rated against every Pokemon in PvPoke's curated meta group using PvPoke's published matchup/counter ratings where available and a type-effectiveness + ranking-score estimate otherwise. teamScore = mean best-member rating across the meta, minus 12 per unanswered meta Pokemon (no member rated above 500) and 6 per meta Pokemon that clearly beats (rating below 400) two or more members. Ratings are on PvPoke's 0-1000 battle-rating scale (500 = even).
